decision.name: Burst of renames to a new extension
decision.reasoning: Burst of renames to a new extension (ATT&CK T1486): renames to a new extension (20 files renamed to .zz7 in 60 s (20 appended, 3 changes of the original extension), last /home/u/docs/f19.odt.zz7) by /home/u/.local/bin/nn-ms-ren (pid 5350003; no package installed it). One shape of ransomware: recorded; with a second one (rewrites, ciphertext, deletions) NN-L-IMP-001 kills
